In late writers, ecbatic, denoting the result, = ὥστε, that, so that (M, Pr., 206ff.; WM, 572; Bl., §69, 3; Burton, §223): [[r:ROM.11.11|Rom 11:11]], [[r:1CO.7.29|1Co 7:29]], [[r:1TH.5.4|1Th 5:4]], al. As in Philo (= ἐξιλάσκ-, in LXX: [[r:EZK.43.22|Eze 43:22]], al.), to expiate, make propitiation for: τ. ἁμαρτίας, [[r:HEB.2.17|Heb 2:17]] (Cremer, 301 ff., 735).† (AS)

senses: Iris, the messenger of the gods.
